import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Fetch hourly AQHI data for station_id 15 from 2025-01-20 to 2025-01-26
# Time window: whole calendar days from 00:00 on 2025-01-20 up to but NOT including 00:00 on 2025-01-27
query = text("""
SELECT station_id, datetime, aqhi, aqhi_level
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
  AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime
""")
aqhi_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total rows fetched for station_id 15 (2025-01-20 to 2025-01-26): {len(aqhi_df)}")
print(f"Date range: {aqhi_df['datetime'].min()} to {aqhi_df['datetime'].max()}")
print(f"Columns: {list(aqhi_df.columns)}")
print(f"Null AQHI count: {aqhi_df['aqhi'].isna().sum()}")
print(f"AQHI stats: min={aqhi_df['aqhi'].min()}, max={aqhi_df['aqhi'].max()}, mean={aqhi_df['aqhi'].mean():.2f}")
print(f"AQHI levels present: {sorted(aqhi_df['aqhi_level'].unique())}")
print()

# Show sample of data
print("Sample rows (first 5):")
print(aqhi_df.head())
print()
print("Sample rows (last 5):")
print(aqhi_df.tail())
print()

# Count per day
aqhi_df['date'] = aqhi_df['datetime'].dt.date
daily_counts = aqhi_df.groupby('date').agg(count=('aqhi', 'count'), mean_aqhi=('aqhi', 'mean')).reset_index()
print("Daily counts and mean AQHI:")
print(daily_counts)
print()

# AQHI thresholds (domain knowledge)
print("=== AQHI Thresholds (Air Quality Health Index) ===")
print("AQHI Range: 1 to 10+ (integer scale)")
print("Risk Levels:")
print("  1-3:  LOW")
print("  4-6:  MODERATE")
print("  7:    HIGH")
print("  8-10: VERY HIGH")
print("  10+:  SERIOUS")
print()
print("AQHI is a health risk-based index derived from the added health risk of 3 pollutants:")
print("  - Ozone (O3)")
print("  - Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2)")
print("  - Particulate Matter (PM2.5 or PM10)")
print("Units: AQHI is dimensionless (index value). Pollutant concentrations are in µg/m³.")

# Verify station name
query = text("SELECT id, name_en, station_type, area_type FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = 15")
station_info = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Station info:")
print(station_info)
print()

# Check for any missing hours (should be 24 per day for 7 days = 168 total)
expected_hours = 7 * 24
actual_hours = len(aqhi_df)
print(f"Expected hours: {expected_hours}, Actual hours: {actual_hours}")
if actual_hours < expected_hours:
    print(f"Missing {expected_hours - actual_hours} hours of data")
    # Check which hours are missing
    full_range = pd.date_range(start='2025-01-20 00:00:00', end='2025-01-26 23:00:00', freq='h')
    missing = full_range[~full_range.isin(aqhi_df['datetime'])]
    if len(missing) > 0:
        print(f"Missing timestamps (first 10): {missing[:10].tolist()}")
else:
    print("All hours present - data is complete")

# Compute weekday mean AQHI (2025-01-20 to 2025-01-24) and weekend mean AQHI (2025-01-25 to 2025-01-26)
# Using the already-fetched aqhi_df

# Weekday period: 2025-01-20 00:00 to 2025-01-25 00:00 (Mon-Fri)
weekday_mask = (aqhi_df['datetime'] >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00') & (aqhi_df['datetime'] < '2025-01-25 00:00:00')
weekday_data = aqhi_df[weekday_mask]

# Weekend period: 2025-01-25 00:00 to 2025-01-27 00:00 (Sat-Sun)
weekend_mask = (aqhi_df['datetime'] >= '2025-01-25 00:00:00') & (aqhi_df['datetime'] < '2025-01-27 00:00:00')
weekend_data = aqhi_df[weekend_mask]

# Compute means
weekday_mean_aqhi_staged = round(float(weekday_data['aqhi'].mean()), 2)
weekend_mean_aqhi_staged = round(float(weekend_data['aqhi'].mean()), 2)

print(f"Weekday period (2025-01-20 to 2025-01-24): {len(weekday_data)} hourly readings")
print(f"  Mean AQHI: {weekday_mean_aqhi_staged}")
print(f"Weekend period (2025-01-25 to 2025-01-26): {len(weekend_data)} hourly readings")
print(f"  Mean AQHI: {weekend_mean_aqhi_staged}")
print()
print("Note: 4 hours missing on 2025-01-21 (13:00-16:00) - weekday mean computed from 116 out of 120 expected hours")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query hourly AQHI for station_id 15 (Central/Western) for the full period 2025-01-20 to 2025-01-26
query = text("""
SELECT datetime, aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
  AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['datetime'])
df['date'] = df['datetime'].dt.date

# Separate into weekday (Mon-Fri: 2025-01-20 to 2025-01-24) and weekend (Sat-Sun: 2025-01-25 to 2025-01-26)
weekday_mask = (df['date'] >= pd.Timestamp('2025-01-20').date()) & (df['date'] <= pd.Timestamp('2025-01-24').date())
weekend_mask = (df['date'] >= pd.Timestamp('2025-01-25').date()) & (df['date'] <= pd.Timestamp('2025-01-26').date())

weekday_data = df[weekday_mask]
weekend_data = df[weekend_mask]

# Compute means
weekday_mean_aqhi_staged = float(weekday_data['aqhi'].mean())
weekend_mean_aqhi_staged = float(weekend_data['aqhi'].mean())

print(f"Number of weekday hours: {len(weekday_data)}")
print(f"Number of weekend hours: {len(weekend_data)}")
print(f"Weekday mean AQHI (2025-01-20 to 2025-01-24): {weekday_mean_aqhi_staged:.4f}")
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI (2025-01-25 to 2025-01-26): {weekend_mean_aqhi_staged:.4f}")

# Assign the final output variables from the staged intermediate values
weekday_mean_aqhi = weekday_mean_aqhi_staged
weekend_mean_aqhi = weekend_mean_aqhi_staged

# Print each required output to confirm
print(f"weekday_mean_aqhi = {weekday_mean_aqhi}")
print(f"weekend_mean_aqhi = {weekend_mean_aqhi}")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query mean AQHI for weekdays Jan 20-24, 2025 (inclusive of both dates)
# Time window: 2025-01-20 00:00 to 2025-01-25 00:00 (24th fully included)
query_weekday = text("""
SELECT AVG(aqhi) as mean_aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
  AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-01-25 00:00:00'
""")
weekday_result = pd.read_sql(query_weekday, engine)
weekday_mean_aqhi = float(weekday_result['mean_aqhi'].iloc[0])
print(f"Weekday mean AQHI (Jan 20-24): {weekday_mean_aqhi}")

# Query mean AQHI for weekend Jan 25-26, 2025 (inclusive of both dates)
# Time window: 2025-01-25 00:00 to 2025-01-27 00:00 (26th fully included)
query_weekend = text("""
SELECT AVG(aqhi) as mean_aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
  AND datetime >= '2025-01-25 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
""")
weekend_result = pd.read_sql(query_weekend, engine)
weekend_mean_aqhi = float(weekend_result['mean_aqhi'].iloc[0])
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI (Jan 25-26): {weekend_mean_aqhi}")

# Also get counts to verify data completeness
query_counts = text("""
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00' AND datetime < '2025-01-25 00:00:00' THEN 'weekday'
    WHEN datetime >= '2025-01-25 00:00:00' AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00' THEN 'weekend'
  END as period,
  COUNT(*) as num_hours,
  MIN(datetime) as first_reading,
  MAX(datetime) as last_reading
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
  AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period
""")
counts = pd.read_sql(query_counts, engine)
print("\nData completeness check:")
print(counts)

# Now verify the values independently - re-query to double-check
